name: Counterbore, helical
author: Acme Machine, programming group
about: Helical counterbore with an end mill smaller than the bore. Goes down in counterclockwise turns of PTCH, takes one flat pass at depth, then moves to the center before retracting. Climb cut.

args.name: CX
args.desc: X at the center of the bore

args.name: CY
args.desc: Y at the center of the bore

args.name: TDIA
args.desc: End mill diameter (must be smaller than BORE)

args.name: PTCH
args.desc: How far down each turn goes

args.name: CLR
args.desc: Rapid to this height before and after

body: IF [#3 GE #7] THEN #3000=1 (TOOL TOO BIG FOR BORE)
notes: Proven on the VF-2 in cell 3, March 2026. Use for the 4140 manifold blocks.
